Name: (FS) Vanilla Shirts for Fashion Sense
Author: TeddyIsTired
Description:
[b][size=4]What is this?[/size][/b]
It's a simple port of several vanilla shirts for Fashion Sense. Some are dyeable, some aren't.
This is mainly a personal mod I made because I enjoy many of the vanilla shirts, but I also like using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19503]Seasonal Farmer Looks[/url] without having to swap shirts manually.

[b][size=4]What you need[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=description]SMAPI [/url]﻿4.0.8 or later
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969?tab=description]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ 6.3.4 or later
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
If you use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41768]Soft Farmer[/url]﻿ mod by Crisaius, check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41963?tab=description]Vanilla Shirts for Soft Farmer[/url]﻿ by trulyvivid!

[size=4][b]This mod currently includes[/b][size=3][i][i][size=1]
(If you want to make your FS less cluttered you can delete any folders of the shirts you don't need!)[/size][/i][/i][/size][/size]

Requests[/size][/b]
If there is a shirt you would like me to add feel free to leave a request. Either give me the name of the shirt you would like to have added, or the material it is made out of. You can look up all vanilla shirts that are in the game [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Tailoring]here[/url].
I am mostly interested in converting shirts as they are (aka non-dyeable) or partially dyeable, but I'm still open to fully dyeable requests! [size=1](No promises if the shirt is really intricate though lol)[/size]

Note that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22556](FS) Customizable Colors for Vanilla [/url]has also converted several shirts (as well as hats) and made them dyeable, so check there too!
The author does not wish to convert shirts that are already dyeable in-game, so I have added most of them myself.
